title: Balls Out: The Making of 'Balls of Fury'
original_title: Balls Out: The Making of 'Balls of Fury'
overview: This “making of” features filmmakers Ben Garant and Tom Lennon discussing their rise from television to the big screen, as well as the training that went into making this film. This tongue-in-cheek “mockumentary” explores a day in the life for the film's ball wrangler.
